text: I have been waiting over an hour for someone to ring me back so I'm writing it down instead. My granddaughter is 4 and her temperature is 38. She was sick once after tea but she's kept her drinks down since, juice and water, no problem. Her breathing is perfectly normal, I've watched her. And no, she hasn't had any fit or shaking or jerking, before anybody asks me that again. I'd just like advice on what to give her and when, please.
